definitions.explanation: The home where one's parents live; one's original family home that one has left.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{実家|じっか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I go home to my parents' place on weekends.

examples.japanese: {実家|じっか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦にある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: My parents' home is in Osaka.

examples.japanese: {実家|じっか}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{送|おく}られてきた→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: Vegetables were sent from my parents' home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}てから→出る：00513_deru⟧{実家|じっか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}れた→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧。
examples.english: I left my parents' home after graduating from university.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{実家|じっか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: For New Year's, the whole family gathers at our parents' home.

notes:
{実家|じっか} refers specifically to one's parents' or birth family's home.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {実家|じっか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧ (to go back to one's parents' home)
- {実家|じっか}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧ (to commute from parents' home)
- {実家|じっか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to leave one's parents' home)
- {実家|じっか}⟦{暮|く}らし→暮らし：02670_kurashi⟧ (living with parents)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {実家|じっか}: parents' home (where parents live)
- ⟦{故郷|ふるさと}→故郷：25466_furusato⟧/⟦{郷里|きょうり}→郷里：18863_kyouri⟧: hometown (place of origin)
- ⟦{本家|ほんけ}→本家：13087_honke⟧: main family house (in extended family)

USAGE NOTES:
- Used when someone has moved out but visits their parents
- Common topic in adult conversations about family
